name: Omatuple
author: Gavin Sottnick
description: Omatuple installs Tuple and runs pair programming from the Omarchy bar: rooms, people, and call controls in one dropdown.

barWidget.description: Sign in, call a teammate, join a room, and control screen sharing without leaving the bar.

schema.label: Show status text next to the bar icon
Notify when a call starts or ends
Warn before sharing your screen (sharing crashes X11 apps)
